content: Official WordPress validate_plugin_requirements documentation says it reads Requires at least and Requires PHP from the main plugin file and returns a WP_Error when requirements are unmet. The official deactivate_plugins reference says plugins commonly use it to deactivate themselves after a dependency check. Core deactivated_plugins_notice documents notices for plugins deactivated during an upgrade; exact behavior for a manual GigPress self-deactivation must be verified in the matrix.
